# Bundled third-party dependency

The archive `xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS dependency used by the spreadsheet preview. Its original license files remain inside the archive and are also included as `xlsx-LICENSE.txt` and `xlsx-dist-LICENSE.txt`. Dependency versions and integrity values remain pinned in the npm lockfile.

Provider artwork provenance is recorded separately at `../apps/knomi/web/public/provider-icons/SOURCES.md`. Other dependencies are installed from their lockfile entries and retain their own license notices.
